name: qu-language
description: Qu scientific scripting language (.qu files): syntax highlighting, run command, and hover, completion, signature help, outline and diagnostics from the qu language server.

qu.executablePath.description: The qu executable: a bare name (default `qu`, looked up on PATH) or a full path such as C:\path\to\qu.exe. `qu editors status` prints the path of the qu that installed this extension.

qu.diagnostics.enable.description: Show live parse-error diagnostics (squiggles + Problems panel) for .qu files, from the language server (`qu lsp`) or, when it is not running, via `qu parse --json`.

qu.languageServer.enable.description: Start `qu lsp` for hover, completion, signature help, the outline, go-to-definition and diagnostics. Needs a qu that has the `lsp` command; with an older qu (or with this off) only syntax highlighting, Run File and `qu parse --json` diagnostics are available.
